name: comp-320
title: Delete Confirm Dialog
description: A trigger opens a dark confirmation dialog with a warning icon and a name field. Delete stays dim until the typed text matches the project name exactly, then turns solid.
use: A destructive action is serious enough that the user must type an exact name first.
avoid: The required project name is a constant in the file, so it must be edited for each use.
a11y: The label is bound to the input and the icon hidden, but Delete has no handler and the unlock is not announced. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Closed, an outlined Delete project button. Open, a narrow dark rounded dialog centred on a warning circle, a bold Final confirmation heading, two centred grey lines naming coss-ui, a Project name label over a long outlined input, and a footer with equal Cancel and Delete buttons.
behaves: Typing updates Delete: it stays dim and disabled until the value is exactly coss-ui, then becomes a white active button. Cancel closes the dialog; Delete itself does nothing.
customise: The project name to type, all copy and the placeholder are hardcoded; the component accepts no props.
weight: light: One dialog and a text comparison; no animation beyond the opening fade.
